description: This file defines a static class 'OpenTypeFontFaceCache' responsible for caching and retrieving OpenType font face objects within the PDFsharp library. It manages font face instances by their name and checksum, provides methods to add, retrieve, reset cache, and generate cache state information.

classes.name: OpenTypeFontFaceCache
classes.description: Manages a global cache of OpenType font faces, allowing lookup by name or checksum, addition of new font faces, resetting cache, and obtaining cache state information.

methods.name: TryGetFontFace
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a font face by its string key.

methods.name: TryGetFontFace
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a font face by its checksum value.

methods.name: AddFontFace
methods.description: Adds a new font face to the cache, ensuring consistency by checksum.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears all cached font face entries.

methods.name: GetCacheState
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the cache's current state.
